en.title: [Korea Data Agency] 2026 Data+AI Innovation Challenge Integrated Competition
summary: The 2026 Data+AI Innovation Challenge (Data Problem-Solving Division) integrated competition is being held.
Participants propose new data recipes and analysis results through the AI·Data Problem-Solving Bank portal and its analysis tools.
Open to any Korean national interested in using data and AI (individually or in teams of up to 5).
The participation period runs from Tuesday, September 8, 2026 to Thursday, October 22, 2026.
Those wishing to participate should contact Professor Kim Seung-hwan (032-860-9446).
See the attached poster and integrated announcement for further details.
en.easyExplanation: This is a challenge where participants propose ideas to solve data and AI problems, open to any Korean national, either individually or as a team of up to 5 people. The participation period is from September 8 to October 22, and anyone wishing to join should contact Professor Kim Seung-hwan.
en.target: Any Korean national interested in using data and AI (individually or in teams of up to 5 people)
